verdict.rationale: Name.com's Core API documents a create-record endpoint that takes type, host, value and TTL, plus a list-records endpoint. It also has Basic-auth access and typed SDKs (TypeScript, Go, PHP) for automation. That covers the create and read parts of CRUD, but the pack shows no update or delete record endpoints, which the story explicitly asks for. Missing for 10: documented update-record endpoint, documented delete-record endpoint, any ACME/DNS-01 challenge guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
